title: Can Occupational Therapy help my child who is overly dependent on certain routines?
metaTitle: Improving Routine Flexibility with Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how Pinnacle Blooms Network's Occupational Therapy aids in gently introducing changes to routines for children with over dependencies, fostering improved flexibility and adaptability.
html: Absolutely. Children, specifically those with autism spectrum disorder, often find comfort and predictability in routines. However, strict adherence to routines can sometimes limit their adaptability. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, our experienced Occupational Therapists implement tailored strategies to gradually introduce changes in routines. This approach enhances flexibility and adaptability in your child, promoting their overall development.
